answer: Reputation-decay escrow. Each identity posts a recurring escrow that decays unless renewed by verified transactions, so a fresh clone starts below the pearl threshold needed to win work. Honest agents keep escrow costs low because renewal is refunded on activity, while an attacker pays the full decay on every clone across the whole horizon of its operation. Reaching the top-tier summit requires sustained renewals, making mass cloning costlier than simply performing honestly.
